## [실습] Docker Compose로 Redis 실행 --- - Docker CLI로 컨테이너 실행 ```bash docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis ``` ### Docker Compose로 컨테이너 실행
1. compose.yml 파일 작성
nginx + redis ```bash services: my-web-server: container_name: webserver image: nginx ports: - 80:80 my-cache-server: container_name: my-redis image: redis ports: - 6379:6379 ```
```bash services: my-cache-server: image: redis ports: - 6379:6379 ```
2. compose 파일 실행 ```bash docker compose up -d ```
3. compose 실행 현황보기 > ❓ > > > > docker compose up vs docker ps > > > 동일: NAME(s), IMAGE, COMMAND, CREATED, STATUS, PORTS > > > > 대부분의 내용은 동일하나 아래와 같은 차이점이 있다. > > - docker compose ps: SERVICE > ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/17d6b54cf92c3b95.webp) > > - docker ps: CONTAINER ID > ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/0903df4c033c1ea0.webp) ```bash docker compose ps ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/7543cf43caf5e3b0.webp) ```bash docker ps ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/6a72fe0b77c5d7c3.webp)
4. 내부 컨테이너의 redis 접속 ```bash # 실행중인 컨테이너 확인 docker compose ps # redis 컨테이너 내부 redis-cli 접속 docker exec -it my-redis redis-cli # 나가기 exit ``` - PING - PONG ```bash ping # PONG ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/e4164e2e319a01d1.webp) - 데이터 저장 및 확인 ```bash set 1 jscode # OK get 1 # "jscode" ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-81fa-8c3b-e565b3dd1bac/532581b65c07ee79.webp)
5. compose 실행된 컨테이너 삭제 ```bash docker compose dowen ```
